lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- What We Are Doing Now
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Mauricio | Lesson 3 -- What We Are Doing Now

listenings.text: Quick update on where we are. Normally we close about forty deals a month, and the process is stable. This quarter is not normal. We are running two systems at the same time, because we are migrating the old one, and that is costing us about a day a week. I am not complaining, I am explaining the numbers. We are currently at thirty-one deals, which is below target, and the deadline for the quarter does not move. What we are doing about it: we are freezing all new requests until the migration finishes, and we are asking for two temporary people, not permanent headcount. That is the whole picture. Questions after, please, not during.

Before we start, let me introduce someone. This is Marta. Marta runs operations for a logistics company in Lisbon, so she oversees about sixty people across three warehouses. What is interesting for us is what she is doing this year: they are moving everything to one single system, and she is the person holding that together. She is also, and I am quoting her, permanently tired. Marta, when you get a moment, tell the group about the workflow you are building. I think half the room has the same problem.
